title: Inventory manager runs the reorder rules: the Office Chair (below its minimum of 10) is ordered from Gemini Furniture
_seedNote: demo seed: rule Office Chair WH/Stock min 10 / max 30 from Gemini Furniture; on hand 8 or less

steps.name: Open Inventory > Reorder rules: the chair rule is listed

outcome.label: an RFQ to Gemini Furniture carries an Office Chair line
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(l.ID) AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLine AS l WHERE l/Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLine_Product/Products.Product/InternalReference = 'FURN_0269' AND l/Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLine_PurchaseOrder/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder/Status = 'RFQ' AND l/Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLine_PurchaseOrder/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder_Vendor/Partners.Partner/Name = 'Gemini Furniture'
